name: tables
description: The CSV Explorer's domain: datasets imported from CSV text, their column profiles, filtering, sorting and grouping, and saved views, kept as JSON in the app's data home. Every page plugin injects this one.
mount: a row `- id: tables` / `name: tables` before the page rows in blend.yaml; a page injects the `tables` service

config.file: the JSON file, relative to the app's home (default csv-explorer.json)
config.clock: what time it is, for tests
config.newId: how ids are made, for tests
